The iii Registry stores immutable worker versions compiled from the repository's root
`worker-compose.yaml`. Define and validate a worker first:

```bash
iii compose validate --file worker-compose.yaml
iii compose descriptor --file worker-compose.yaml --worker my-worker --source-sha "$GIT_SHA" --output release-descriptor.json
```

Publishing uses the compiler-owned `package` object and `descriptor_sha256` from that release
descriptor. Name, version, artifact kind, runtime, description, license, tags, dependencies, and
configuration defaults are derived from the package descriptor rather than repeated in a second
payload schema.

Candidate publication creates one immutable package version and moves `@next`. Stable promotion is
a compare-and-swap of `@latest` to the same version, descriptor digest, and artifacts; it does not
rebuild or create a second package version.

## Install

```bash
iii worker add my-worker@1.2.3
```

`iii worker add` accepts Registry references only. The resolver returns the exact
`package_descriptor`, its digest, dependency graph, and immutable artifacts. iii verifies the
descriptor digest, artifact checksum or OCI digest, installs the payload, and writes the identical
descriptor and digest to `iii.lock`.

Use `iii compose up` for local source. Direct local paths and arbitrary OCI references are not an
`iii worker add` surface.

## Bundle archives

JavaScript and Python archives contain exactly the files listed by `artifact.include`, preserving
their paths relative to `source.path`. iii installs the verified archive with
`.iii-package-descriptor.json` and `.iii-package-descriptor.sha256` sidecars. Startup reads only
those sidecars and the immutable lock; it never reconstructs metadata from files inside the bundle.

`runtime.exec` runs from the extracted archive root (`/workspace` in the VM). Build-time
`install_command` and `build_command` are never used as runtime defaults. A boot-time
`runtime.prepare` must consume packaged local content and runs inside the descriptor's digest-pinned
base image.
